patches.reason: Connect the complete Android 17 AOSP Dialer Telecom lifecycle to model priority and the fail-closed AIOS Call Intelligence policy and capture service.
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if AOSP exposes an equivalent stable call-assistant lifecycle API requiring no Dialer source hook.
patches.rebase_notes: Re-export from the tracked Dialer base, preserve the four-file footprint, then rerun host validation, preview builds, emulator Telecom smoke, and every physical dialer/call gate.

patches.reason: Allow the platform-signed AIOS Messaging app to statically link AOSP's maintained MMS codec and Telephony provider persister without copying protocol sources into vendor code, using Soong's required platform-to-vendor subtree visibility boundary.
patches.removal_condition: Remove when framework-mms-shared-srcs is public to product modules or AOSP provides an equivalent supported MMS codec and provider library.
patches.rebase_notes: Re-export from the tracked frameworks/base commit, keep the change to the single telephony/common/Android.bp visibility entry using //vendor:__subpackages__, and rebuild AiosMessaging with Soong.

patches.reason: Preserve AOSP's compliance-GSI defaults while allowing an additive product to size its model-inclusive build container, declare its package closure to Android 17's Soong system-image check, and align that image with the board's chained GSI AVB key.
patches.removal_condition: Remove the sizing hunk when AOSP exposes a product-supported GSI sizing mechanism; remove the filesystem wrapper when additive products can extend android_gsi through a public Soong interface.
patches.rebase_notes: Re-export from the tracked build/make base, preserve the two conditional size defaults and adjacent android_gsi_defaults wrapper, verify the default GSI remains 3 GiB, verify AIOS resolves its generated payload and 6 GiB group, then require chained AVB verification of vbmeta plus system.

patches.reason: Establish AIOS Home on the exact Android 17 Launcher3 base, expose the configured system assistant through the standard Android intent contract, and selectively carry independently useful GrapheneOS grid, search UX, and crash fixes without Graphene branding or service coupling.
patches.removal_condition: Remove individual carried fixes when upstream Launcher3 provides equivalent behavior; remove the topic only if AIOS stops shipping a launcher or upstream provides equivalent product branding and assistant-first workspace hooks.
patches.rebase_notes: Re-export from the next official Android release tag, audit every carried fix against upstream before reapplying it, preserve package identity and colored-icon defaults, then test clean setup, every phone grid, workspace migration, app-drawer search/back behavior, user switching, Quickstep, gestures, widgets, rotation, and assistant fallback.
